Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by introducing an unnecessary temporal constraint (“spouse as of the film’s release year, 1967”). The question simply asks for the spouse of the film’s director (Karel Kachyňa), which standardly refers to the director’s spouse (commonly recorded as Alena Mihulová), not specifically the spouse in 1967. This led the workflow toward identifying the first wife (Eliška Kuchařová) and chasing marriage-year details, causing the wrong answer trajectory.
